cases.title: Conflicting terminal evidence and distinct assessment bases

cases.title: Parser correction on unchanged native evidence
cases.expected_readout: New interpretation, same native evidence; no native rerun and no erasure of the old interpretation.

cases.title: Complete publication of deliberately partial evidence
cases.expected_readout: Published package completeness is scoped to its manifest, not to complete original evidence. Declaration lacks bytes and a computed digest.

cases.title: Local result with allowed abstention and a distinct ranking
cases.expected_readout: Finality and fulfillment are request-specific; local membership, predictive ranking and global graph structure are not interchangeable.

metadata_notes: Native format coverage and omission semantics are explicit source content in graph cases.

Missing optional contracts are not declarations that the entire native system lacks them.
Original producer identity is separate from importer/decoder identity; unidentified historical native producers use unresolved typed references.
Coverage and omission are structured expressions, not prose to be parsed. Record order is not execution order; native member ordering is explicit.
